propositions: get_parent_map, get_comment_map, and get_issuelinks_map each paginate whole projects through opaque nextPageToken cursors but have no test exercising more than one page.

The three Cloud readers lack multi-page test coverage equivalent to DC's pagination tests (test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py), creating parity gap where same defect class has shipped three times on DC and been fixed each time only after production discovery.

Each reader terminates on isLast OR null/absent nextPageToken, but nothing asserts the cursor advances, second page is fetched and merged, or repeated tokens do not spin forever—silent truncation here is invisible to the differ.
A repeated or stalled nextPageToken can cause infinite loop with fail-open exception handling, resulting in silently partial maps visible only as missing parents/comments/links.
